notes.title: New UI Graphics, Zombies Map, and Major Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
I'm excited to share a new update packed with fresh UI graphics, a new challenging zombies map, and many important fixes.

User Interface and Graphics
[list] 
[*] Revamped UI: I've given the user interface a complete overhaul, making it cleaner and more intuitive. [*] Red UI Health Effect: I’ve added a red health effect to reflect the players health state. 
[/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721465/e202ffb6fe3d77d26dd1af73dedcc158f2cc0f31.png[/img]

New Zombies Additions
[list] 
[*] New Zombies Map - Bank: The Largest map added so far!
[*] Weapons Supercharger: Updgrade your weapons
[*] Tweaked Zombie Spawning System: I've adjusted how zombies spawn to improve spawn point selection 
[*] Optimized Zombie AI: I found and fixed a bug that was causing high network load from the zombie AI, which should result in smoother gameplay, especially during the large late game action.
[/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721465/de122c7073391a8769b12b37ff75cb6bad054327.png[/img]

Bug Fixes & Optimizations
This update also includes a series of bug fixes and optimizations to improve the game's overall performance and stability. However, being a solo developer issues oftern go un-noticed, so please write any issues found in the discord server! https://discord.gg/QyABs5K6Et


I hope you enjoy the new update! As always, your feedback is really important to me, so feel free to share your thoughts.

notes.title: Bug Fixes and a few additions
notes.notes:
-Network Error freezing game when returning to menu now fixed.
-1 Non Ready player holding lobby, now only 50% of lobby require to be ready to start.
-Quick Play (a new button to join the fullest lobby with the most players from any game mode)
-discord button (join the wheels of duty Discord from in the game)
-players leaving the match are now replaced with a bot
-few additional objects for cover in the Town Map
-shotgun damage improved
-Smg damage improved and recoil reduction
-shield time reduced
